title: Celestial Dream Voyage
description: A small wooden sailboat sails on a turbulent dark blue sea beneath a massive cosmic entity resembling a smiling face formed from swirling purple, orange and blue clouds. The giant celestial being dominates the sky, surrounded by dramatic colorful clouds, glowing stars and ethereal light trails.
prompt: A lone wooden sailboat navigates a stormy dark ocean at twilight. In the sky above, a colossal cosmic being shaped like a smiling face emerges from swirling nebulae and colorful clouds in shades of purple, orange and blue. Dramatic volumetric lighting, glowing particles, stars and light streaks fill the surreal dreamlike scene.
